comparison.objective: Torque a lug bolt with a click wrench and stop immediately at its one-shot break-over cue.
comparison.physical_skill: Steady torque application and rapid cessation on tactile/tool motion feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Click occurs with peak torque in the 90–110% band, no reversal or over-torque, then tool released and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Both regulate tool-applied load, but this task avoids crossing a torque limit and leaves the joint intact; the candidate must deliberately exceed a notch-fracture threshold through axial hammer impact and recover the debris.
